description: Election Commission - Declare that A. G. D. R. Premalal  as a member of the Panduwasnuwaqra P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Panduwasnuwara Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes, including the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves electoral procedures and declarations related to local authority elections.
